product_change: Compute the live preparedMessages projection once per view evaluation and pass it to rows, jump readiness, and follow-latest observers in room and reply-thread views. No persistent cache or domain changes.
method: Identical inlined harness probes before/after, 12 cases each: room/thread x 50/500/2000 total messages x plain/mixed content. One run per cell. Native wheel events; phase boundaries and counters retained. One paired Time Profiler capture on the 2000-message plain room, bounded by unified-log early-phase timestamps; timings describe these runs, not presented-frame FPS.
environment: Apple M4 Pro, 24 GiB, macOS 27.0 (26A428), Xcode 27.0 (27A266a), arm64 Release -O, ENABLE_CODE_COVERAGE=NO and CLANG_ENABLE_CODE_COVERAGE=NO.
